criteria.review: A confirmation candidate remains advisory until the current correlated proposal is deterministically admitted.
A complete revision is represented only as a new visible proposal candidate and is not profile publication.
A proposal question preserves the displayed proposal and returns bounded feedback only.
Ambiguous language remains clarification and cannot invent a profile change.
Instruction-like reply text cannot select a route, write State, publish a profile, or invoke a tool.
Repair receives the same bounded assignment and invalid draft, then still requires parser/materializer admission.

limited_conditions: A credentialed live run is unavailable after strict credential preflight.
A mechanically valid candidate has insufficient retained evidence for one bounded criterion.
inconclusive_conditions: The retained execution cannot connect a candidate to the declared capability and schema digests.
failed_conditions: A capability result publishes a profile, writes State, selects a route, or invokes a tool.
